steps.summary: Added upcoming and completed note views with active status management.
Added configurable note reminders, periodic polling, and persistent UI notifications.
Added recurring note settings with selectable frequency and repeat end date.
Fixed NoteUpdate recurrence fields and expanded daily, weekly, and monthly notes for calendar queries.
Added month, week, and day calendar views with editable drag-and-drop note rescheduling.
Added an email emulator and a 30-second background scheduler that sends due reminders once.
Enabled authenticated WebSocket connections and automatic note list refreshes for create, update, and delete events.
Resolved virtual occurrence IDs to master notes and synchronized dismissed reminder modals across tabs.
Added persistent occurrence exceptions, single-occurrence edit/delete handling, and per-occurrence reminder deliveries.
Added a reactive user settings timezone store and applied timezone-aware formatting to calendar, cards, reminders, and note forms without changing UTC reminder times.
Added a full note list screen with SQL-backed search, date range, status, multi-tag filters, and event/update sorting.
Refined the trash UI, added a custom ConfirmModal, and implemented note restoration and permanent deletion.
Bound user profiles, notes, and tags to email with account switching and email-scoped API requests.
Added email format validation, normalization, placeholder, disabled invalid submit states, and a clear validation message.

steps.scope: Assignment 1 Notetaker requirements and general submission requirements
fully_met: Separate Vue/Vite frontend and FastAPI/Python backend communicating over HTTP.
PostgreSQL relational persistence for users, notes, tags, reminders and recurrence exceptions.
Notes CRUD, active/inactive state, soft-delete trash, restore and permanent deletion.
Tags with create, rename, delete, color and multiple tags per note.
Daily, weekly and monthly recurrence with end date and persisted single-occurrence exceptions.
Month, week and day calendar views, date navigation, grid creation and drag-and-drop rescheduling.
Server-side list search, date range filters, status filters, multi-tag filters and event/update sorting including old/new update date.
Email emulator and background reminder scheduler; repeat delivery records prevent duplicate recurring deliveries.
In-app reminder modal, localStorage dismissal persistence and cross-tab dismissal propagation over WebSocket.
Optimistic version conflict detection with HTTP 409 and user-facing reload action.
Realtime note-created/updated/deleted refreshes verified between two browser pages.
Local Playwright E2E evidence exists for the main workflows and notification delivery.

partially_met_or_missing.reason: The list query is server-filtered but has no pagination, limit/offset or cursor. The frontend renders the complete returned collection, so the requirement for several thousand notes to open and scroll without delay is not demonstrated or guaranteed.

The scheduler persists data across restart and sends due reminders after downtime, but the current query can send an overdue reminder after a note is reactivated or restored. The TЗ explicitly says activation after the deadline must not back-send past reminders; this policy is not implemented explicitly.
Email scheduler checks every 30 seconds and browser in-app polling checks every 15 seconds, so delivery is near the requested moment rather than an exact-time guarantee.
Tags are filtered by user in API usage, but Tag.name has a global unique constraint. Two accounts cannot independently create tags with the same name.

The repository has a decisions log and execution trace, but no root README with deployment prerequisites, startup steps, complete working/not-working status, missed-reminder policy, next steps and explicit AI tool/model description. frontend/README.md is still the default Vite template.

not_required_or_acceptable_assumptions: JWT/password authentication is not required by the assignment; email-header account identification is documented as the chosen lightweight model.
Email is emulated locally, which is explicitly allowed by the assignment.
steps.overall_assessment: The implemented product now satisfies the core interactive Notetaker workflows and the previously found realtime/filter/sort deviations are fixed. It is not fully compliant with the complete assignment yet because large-list scalability, explicit missed-reminder semantics and final submission documentation remain incomplete.

Added suppression of overdue one-time and recurring reminder deliveries when an inactive note is activated or restored after the reminder deadline.
